meta.name: paperclip-create-agent
meta.description: Create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring. Use when you need to inspect adapter configuration options, compare existing agent configs, draft a new agent prompt/config, and submit a hire request.

copy.tagline: 在 Paperclip 中创建并招聘新 agent
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在 Paperclip 平台中创建新 agent 并提交招聘请求。
copy.tagline_en: Create and hire new agents in Paperclip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create new agents and submit hire requests in Paperclip.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你创建新的 Paperclip 智能体。它会检查你的权限，获取适配器配置，对比现有智能体，起草新智能体的提示词和配置，最后提交雇佣请求。
howto.when: 当你要求雇佣或创建一个新的 Paperclip 智能体时触发。需要 Paperclip 已安装运行，且你有 board 权限或公司授予的创建权限。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 CTO 智能体。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行创建流程，包括检查权限、获取配置等。

say.text: 为我的项目雇佣一个后端工程师智能体。
say.note: Claude 会选择合适的模板并起草配置。

say.text: 查看当前可用的智能体图标列表。
say.note: Claude 会调用 API 获取图标列表供你选择。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create new Paperclip agents. It checks your permissions, fetches adapter configuration, compares existing agents, drafts the new agent's prompt and config, and submits a hire request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to hire or create a new Paperclip agent. Requires Paperclip to be installed and running, and you must have board access or agent permission can_create_agents=true.

say_en.text: Create a new CTO agent for me.
Hire a backend engineer agent for my project.
say_en.note: Claude will select an appropriate template and draft the configuration.

say_en.text: Show me the list of available agent icons.
say_en.note: Claude will call the API to retrieve the icon list for you to choose from.
